comment: The formula is at Osc6.cpp:267 in the maker's own words: x and t times xc shifted by xa, or t times xd shifted by xb, multiplied by yp plus the same construction on y times ym. The X and Y jacks add their bits to the switches rather than replacing them, Osc6.cpp:148-165, so a switch left on cannot be cleared by cable. The ten value jacks are read once every few samples and move their knobs, Osc6.cpp:121. Bits above the Bits setting are ignored. The maker ships factory presets, which are the quickest way into the module.
